stem: In which of the following relief sculpture inscriptions is 'Ranyo Ashoka' (King Ashoka) mentioned along with the stone portrait of Ashoka?

ex.summary: The ruined stupa at Kanaganahalli, part of the Sannati complex on the Bhima in Kalaburagi (Gulbarga) district of Karnataka, yielded a relief of Ashoka with his queens that carries an inscription naming him. That is the site the question describes.

hook: Where is Ashoka's portrait carved with his name?

aarav.line: Ashoka's stupa, famous reliefs. Sanchi, obviously.

priya.line: Wait. The named portrait is at Kanaganahalli.

verdicts.p: Stupa relief: Ashoka's portrait, his name inscribed.
Ashoka began the stupa; no portrait labelled with his name.
Shahbazgarhi: rock edicts. Sohgaura: a copper plate.

points.p: near Sannati, on the Bhima, Kalaburagi district.
Major Rock Edicts in Kharosthi script (now Pakistan).

remember: Ashoka's portrait with his name: Kanaganahalli, Karnataka.
trap: Aarav saw 'Ashoka' and 'relief' and jumped to Sanchi. Ashokan stupa, yes; named portrait, no.
method: Match every clue: portrait plus name rules out edict-only sites.
topic: History · Ashoka in inscriptions & Buddhist art

bonus.short: Which ruler's inscription warned that praising your own sect while blaming others injures your own?

reply_right: Kanaganahalli's stupa relief shows Ashoka's portrait with his name inscribed.
reply_trap: Sanchi's stupa is Ashokan, but the portrait carrying his name is at Kanaganahalli.
